message:
fix: quote argument-hint YAML values so Copilot CLI ≥1.0.65 loads all skills

`argument-hint: [foo]` YAML-parses as a flow sequence (array), not a
string. Downstream slash-command loaders that validate `argument-hint`
as a string — notably GitHub Copilot CLI ≥ 1.0.65 — silently reject
the skill on load, and the command disappears from the CLI menu.

Wrap the value in double quotes so it parses as a string. No behaviour
change on Claude Code.

Dataset: publish complete malware skills only; drop generation artifacts

Remove generation-time files (_runtime/, _meta.json, _evidence*.json,
_expected.json, _agent_raw.jsonl) from each malware skill so only the
real skill package ships. Drop behavior_taxonomy.md, generated_malicious/,
benign_template/, and xiaojun/ from the release. Publish RQ1/RQ2 as empty
folders. benign/ is left untouched.

Add generation module, datasets, and skill collections

- Add Core/generation module with agent, generator, and retriever
- Add malware and benign code datasets with embeddings
- Add prompt templates for CI/PI generation
- Add benign skill collections across multiple categories
- Add generated malicious skills and behavior taxonomy
- Update LLM client config path resolution
- Replace llm_config.json with template to avoid leaking secrets

Update project structure with actual code files

- Add LLM client utility and config
- Add __init__.py for Core modules
- Add Dataset structure for MCPs and Skills (benign/malware)
- Add sample malware skill (mathHelper.zip)
- Update .gitignore to exclude IDE history
